newsitem.title: ITALY: BNL in 1.3 trln lire financing for API.
newsitem.headline: BNL in 1.3 trln lire financing for API.

text.p: Italian bank Banca Nazionale del Lavoro said it will with other banks arrange a project financing deal worth over 1.3 trillion lire ($763.3 million) for the construction of a gasification plant at API Energia's refinery.

API Energia is a joint project formed by Anonima Petroli Italiana SpA and multinational Asea Brown Boveri and with its refinary at Falconara in eastern Italy. It is one of three major Italian gasification projects currently underway.
BNL said in a statement other arrangers were ABN-AMRO, UBS, Chase Manhattan, NatWest Markets, San Paolo di Torino and Mediocredito Centrale.
The operation had been a great success, BNL said, with the market offering 2.6 trillion lire on top of the 1.0 trillion lire already underwritten by the arranger banks.
